page.overview:
Who is Felaana Bevaine?

Felaana is slim with yellow hair and a raspy voice. Egwene thinks that her hair gleams as if she brushes it several times a day.

Felaana is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

While Moiraine Damodred is out searching for the Dragon Reborn she meets up with several Aes Sedai in Kandor, Felaana being one among them. Felaana thinks she is a Wilder rather than an Aes Sedai who has not reached the ageless look yet and tries to convice Moiraine to come to the White Tower.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.
